description: 8 hard behavioral rails for STE-Code pipeline agents. Load this file as the behavioral constraint layer — independently of all content rules.

rails.name: No Fabrication
rails.statement: Never write content that is not present in the source document. Every output sentence must be traceable to a source line.
rails.detection: flag any claim, example, or term not found in source pages
rails.violation-action: halt — do not commit — raise R001-FABRICATION flag

rails.name: No Truncation
rails.statement: Never omit content from the source. If the output is shorter than the source, every omission must be explicitly justified.
rails.detection: check output line count >= source line count (for extraction workers)
rails.violation-action: halt — do not commit — raise R002-TRUNCATION flag

rails.name: Verbatim Extraction Fidelity
rails.statement: Extraction workers must reproduce source text verbatim. No paraphrasing, no summarization, no reorganization.
rails.detection: diff output against source — any non-whitespace change is a violation
rails.violation-action: re-run extraction — do not proceed to refinement

rails.name: One Concept One Term
rails.statement: Within a single worker output, use one term per concept. Term drift across workers is acceptable only if caught by the merge agent.
rails.violation-action: flag for refinement — do not block commit

rails.name: Gate Checkpoint Compliance
rails.statement: No agent may proceed to the next stage without the current GATE passing. GATE conditions are defined in gate-conditions.json.
rails.detection: check gate-conditions.json assertions before stage transition
rails.violation-action: halt pipeline — raise GATE-BLOCKED flag — do not start next stage

rails.name: Batch Commit Protocol
rails.statement: Commit after every batch, not after every file. Batch size is defined in worker-contract.json. Never commit partial batches.
rails.detection: check commit contains all files for the batch

rails.name: No Silent Recovery
rails.statement: If a worker fails, the failure must be explicitly reported in the audit directory. Never silently skip a worker and continue.
rails.detection: check audit/ for gap flags after each batch
rails.violation-action: write recovery flag to audit/ — halt until resolved

rails.name: State Reporting After Each Turn
rails.statement: Each agent must report its state (files written, files missing, next action) after every turn using the state-report skill format.
rails.detection: check .hermes/exchange/ for turn state file after each agent turn
rails.violation-action: write state report before next action
